definitions.explanation: Each and every day; daily. Used to express something that happens or is done on a daily basis. Can function as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}しています。
{毎日|まいにち}{朝|あさ}ごはんを{食|た}べますか。
examples.english: Do you eat breakfast every day?

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{同|おな}じ{時間|じかん}に{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up at the same time every day.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{夜|よる}{寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{三十|さんじゅっ}{分|ぷん}くらい{本|ほん}を{読|よ}むのが{好|す}きです。
examples.english: I like to read for about thirty minutes before going to bed every night.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{仕事|しごと}に{行|い}くのは{大変|たいへん}ですが、{休|やす}みの{日|ひ}は{家|いえ}でゆっくりしています。
examples.english: Going to work every day is tough, but on my days off I relax at home.

notes:
{毎日|まいにち} means "every day" - can function as a noun or adverb.

GRAMMAR:
As an adverb, typically comes at the beginning or before the verb:
- {毎日|まいにち}{勉強|べんきょう}する (study every day)

{毎|まい}〜 SERIES:
- {毎日|まいにち}: every day
- {毎朝|まいあさ}: every morning
- {毎晩|まいばん}: every night
- {毎週|まいしゅう}: every week
- {毎月|まいつき}: every month
- {毎年|まいとし/まいねん}: every year

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {日々|ひび}: day by day, daily (more literary)
- {毎日|まいにち}のように: almost every day

NOTE:
{毎|まい} prefix means "every" or "each."
